information:
We are excited to announce you the 1st Indian Elite Championship!
![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MjA3MTY4LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--7de95ad822e6b6e8717e3f6c3b689bab2c2b4d8e/logo_colored_cropped.png)

**Free T-Shirt**: All registered competitors will receive a free t-shirt. Please fill in your t-shirt size in the comment box when registering. More info [here](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/IndianEliteChampionship2026#79537-goodies)

**FMC and PBQ Events**: A separate championship will be held for [FMC](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/IndianFMCChampionship2026) and PBQ events this year. Please stay tuned for the announcements [here](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions?region=IN) 

For more updates, follow us in our [instagram page](https://www.instagram.com/speedcubers_india?igsh=Mm5tZ3c1OHIxZ25n) and join us in [whatsapp](https://chat.whatsapp.com/KLb1PnmJgclDAhyx4WGK0c)
